examples.question: show faculty
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM faculty ORDER BY faculty_id ASC

examples.question: show classes
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM classes ORDER BY class_id ASC

examples.question: show courses
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM courses ORDER BY course_id ASC

examples.question: show students
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY student_id ASC

examples.question: show exams
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM exams ORDER BY exam_id ASC

examples.question: show results
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY result_id ASC

examples.question: count students by class
examples.sql: SELECT classes.class_id, classes.class_name, COUNT(students.student_id) AS student_count FROM classes LEFT JOIN students ON students.class_id=classes.class_id GROUP BY classes.class_id, classes.class_name ORDER BY classes.class_id

examples.question: show students with marks above 80
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_id AS students_student_id, students.student_name AS students_student_name, results.result_id AS results_result_id, results.exam_id AS results_exam_id, results.marks AS results_marks FROM results JOIN students ON results.student_id = students.student_id WHERE results.marks > 80 ORDER BY results.result_id ASC

examples.question: show students with marks between 60 and 80
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_id AS students_student_id, students.student_name AS students_student_name, results.result_id AS results_result_id, results.exam_id AS results_exam_id, results.marks AS results_marks FROM results JOIN students ON results.student_id = students.student_id WHERE results.marks BETWEEN 60 AND 80 ORDER BY results.result_id ASC

examples.question: show top 5 results with highest marks
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY marks DESC, result_id ASC LIMIT 5

examples.question: show courses and faculty
examples.sql: SELECT courses.course_id AS courses_course_id, courses.course_name AS courses_course_name, faculty.faculty_name AS faculty_faculty_name FROM courses JOIN faculty ON courses.faculty_id = faculty.faculty_id ORDER BY courses.course_id ASC

examples.question: show student name and class name
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_name AS students_student_name, classes.class_name AS classes_class_name FROM students JOIN classes ON students.class_id = classes.class_id ORDER BY students.student_id ASC

examples.question: show students in semester 3
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_id AS students_student_id, students.student_name AS students_student_name FROM students JOIN classes ON students.class_id = classes.class_id WHERE classes.semester = 3 ORDER BY students.student_id ASC

examples.question: average marks per course
examples.sql: SELECT courses.course_id, courses.course_name, AVG(results.marks) AS average_marks FROM courses LEFT JOIN exams ON exams.course_id=courses.course_id LEFT JOIN results ON results.exam_id=exams.exam_id GROUP BY courses.course_id, courses.course_name ORDER BY courses.course_id

examples.question: average marks per student
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_id, students.student_name, AVG(results.marks) AS average_marks FROM students LEFT JOIN results ON results.student_id=students.student_id GROUP BY students.student_id, students.student_name ORDER BY students.student_id

examples.question: show students without results
examples.sql: SELECT students.* FROM students WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM results WHERE results.student_id=students.student_id) ORDER BY students.student_id

examples.question: show faculty without courses
examples.sql: SELECT faculty.* FROM faculty WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM courses WHERE courses.faculty_id=faculty.faculty_id) ORDER BY faculty.faculty_id

examples.question: show faculty with experience above 10
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM faculty WHERE experience > 10 ORDER BY faculty_id ASC

examples.question: show courses with credits at least 4
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE credits >= 4 ORDER BY course_id ASC

examples.question: show students in class CSE-3A
examples.sql: SELECT students.student_id AS students_student_id, students.student_name AS students_student_name FROM students JOIN classes ON students.class_id = classes.class_id WHERE LOWER(classes.class_name) = 'cse-3a' ORDER BY students.student_id ASC

examples.question: show name and email from students
examples.sql: SELECT student_name, email FROM students ORDER BY student_id ASC
